description: This file defines an abstract class PdfNumber that serves as a base for representing numeric values in the PDFsharp library, including properties that indicate the type of number (integer, long integer, real).

classes.name: PdfNumber
classes.description: Abstract base class for direct number values within the PDFsharp library, providing properties to indicate the specific numeric type.

methods.name: IsInteger
methods.description: Property indicating if the number is a 32-bit signed integer.

methods.name: IsLongInteger
methods.description: Property indicating if the number is a 64-bit signed integer.

methods.name: IsReal
methods.description: Property indicating if the number is a floating point value.
